comment: Expected failures caused by the Rust SDK or the Rust interop programs (programs/rust). See README.md in this directory.

expectations.reason: The Java agent answers the session-scoped POST of session/delete for an unknown Acp-Session-Id with 404 (RFD rule); the Rust HTTP client treats any non-2xx POST as fatal (handle_completed_post, client.rs:393-396, from :236-239), ends the whole connection, and the request fails with 'response never received'
